rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for quantity, amount, or number, especially in neutral comparisons and measurements.

example.english: The quantity of this batch is greater than last month.
example.traditional: 呢批貨嘅數量比上個月多。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 ge3 sou3 loeng6 bei2 soeng6 go3 jyut6 do1

rows.note: Use this for the amount or portion of something such as food, liquid, ingredients, or work.

example.english: The quantity of soup in this bowl is just right.
example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 fan6 loeng6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the quantity is notably large or considerable rather than merely unspecified.

example.english: We bought a large quantity of face masks.
example.traditional: 我哋公司買咗大量口罩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 maai5 zo2 daai6 loeng6 hau2 zaau3
